## Core Expertise
- **Frontend & Interactive Web**: React 19, Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack, Server Actions), TypeScript, Three.js, WebGL, GSAP (ScrollTrigger), Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS.
- **Backend & AI Systems**: Python 3.12, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pgvector (semantic search, embeddings), Redis, WeasyPrint deterministic PDF engines, asynchronous durable job queues, OpenAI API, LangChain.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Artifact Registry), Docker containerization, Brotli-enabled Nginx reverse proxies, Vercel edge networks, CI/CD automated deployment pipelines.
- **Computer Science & Low-Level Foundations**: V8 JavaScript Engine internals (heap memory allocations, execution context stacks, garbage collection algorithms, hidden classes), Data Structures & Algorithms, contiguous memory layouts, pointer arithmetic.

## Flagship Systems & Live Work

### 1. JavaScript Universe (V8 Engine & Memory Visualizer)
- **URL**: https://hub-bay-six-16.vercel.app/ (Hub) & https://variables-pi.vercel.app/ (Variables & Memory Observatory)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/MRGokulB/js-mastery
- **Summary**: An engine-level, hardware-conscious interactive learning platform modeling V8 runtime internals, execution context stacks, heap memory allocations, and closures with cinematic scroll storytelling.
- **Key Modules**: Physical Mental Models spread, Spatial Memory Observatory (Call Stack vs V8 Heap with live Bezier pointers), Temporal Dead Zone (TDZ) Chamber with bytecode compilation telemetry, Mutation & Clone Studio, and Mark-and-Sweep Garbage Collection Simulator.

### 2. DSA Universe (Hardware-Level Algorithm Visualizer)
- **URL**: https://home-two-rust.vercel.app/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/MRGokulB/dsa-universe
- **Summary**: A decoupled micro-frontend monorepo presenting algorithmic mechanics through reactive animations, silicon-level contiguous memory allocation, pointer arithmetic, and cycle detection across 7 independent applications.
- **Key Modules**: Arrays & Memory Layout, Linked Lists (pointer traversal and reversal), Stacks & Queues, Binary Trees & Traversals, Graph Cycle Detection, and Dynamic Programming tabular memory models.

### 3. Autonomous Proposal Capture & Compliance Engine
- **Summary**: An enterprise capture platform orchestrating RFP solicitation interpretation, pgvector semantic search, async durable task execution, and deterministic WeasyPrint PDF compilation.
- **Stack**: FastAPI, Python, PostgreSQL/pgvector, Cloud Run, Docker, WeasyPrint.

### 4. Enclavia.ai Digital Infrastructure
- **URL**: https://enclavia.ai/
- **Summary**: Enterprise AI platform featuring build-time prerendered SEO/AEO architectures, containerized Brotli Nginx deployments on Cloud Run, and modular AI product suites.
- **Stack**: React 19, Python (FastAPI), pgvector, Cloud Run, Docker, GCP.
